name: Glass Icons
description: Glossy translucent 3D app icons in Three.js, floating on a soft mint, sky and peach gradient, each with a white symbol on its face, frosted labels and a crisp black headline.
best_use_cases: Lists where each item deserves a moment
style: 3D glossy icons: rounded squares with bevel, clearcoat and slight transparency in soft colours, white 3D symbols on the face, mint-sky-peach gradient background, frosted info cards with mono number and one-line benefit, Inter 900 headlines.
